items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cuts Astra API prices 20%
items.quote: standard rates for Astra fell to $8 per million uncached input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, down 20% from GPT-6 Astra
items.claim: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol on Nov. 17, 2026; Astra's standard API rates fell to $8 per million uncached input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, 20% below GPT-6 Astra.
items.why_it_matters: Cheaper flagship API tokens lower the cost of agent and coding projects; Sol at $2/$10 per million tokens suits student budgets.
items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cutting Astra API rates 20%

items.headline: TrendForce expects NAND contract prices to fall from 1Q27
items.quote: TrendForce forecasts overall NAND flash contract prices falling by 0-5 percent quarter on quarter in early 2027
items.claim: TrendForce forecasts NAND flash contract prices to fall 0-5 percent QoQ in early 2027, with all product categories in a downturn from the second quarter, as Chinese cloud operators cut enterprise SSD orders.
items.why_it_matters: SSD prices may ease in 2027, but TrendForce says cheaper flash won't fix the DRAM squeeze, so laptop RAM upgrades stay costly.
items.title: NAND prices tipped to fall as Chinese cloud giants cut SSD orders

items.headline: NAND spot prices fell about 20% in two weeks
items.quote: TrendForce has lowered its forecast for contract price increases in the fourth quarter of 2026 to 8–13%
items.claim: TrendForce cut its 4Q26 NAND contract price increase forecast to 8-13%, and spot prices have recently fallen by more than 20% as distributors clear inventory.
items.why_it_matters: Spot SSD and flash costs are already softening, so waiting on an SSD purchase may pay off.
items.title: NAND flash prices set to fall in 2027 as Chinese cloud firms cut or...

items.headline: Sarvam releases open-weight Sarvam-105B-1711 checkpoint
items.quote: its average across eight conversational agent benchmarks rose from 42.6 to 73.9
items.claim: Sarvam released Sarvam-105B-1711, a new open-weight checkpoint of Sarvam 105B trained on B200 infrastructure; its average across eight conversational agent benchmarks rose from 42.6 to 73.9 versus the February release, and blended price fell by two-thirds from $0.44.
items.why_it_matters: A stronger Indic-capable open-weight model you can self-host or call cheaply for voice and support agents.
items.title: Sarvam-105B-1711: a new Sarvam 105B checkpoint | Sarvam AI

items.headline: Sarvam launches Token Factory inference platform in India
items.quote: Token Factory is our inference stack to serve our own models and leading open-weight models from GPU clusters located in India.
items.claim: Sarvam launched Token Factory on 16 Nov 2026, an inference stack serving its own and leading open-weight models from GPU clusters located in India.
items.why_it_matters: An India-hosted API for open models gives builders lower latency and data-residency options.
items.title: Introducing Sarvam Token Factory | Sarvam AI

items.headline: Sarvam says Token Factory uses no subsidised GPUs amid Chinese-model row
items.quote: The company said its subsidised access under the IndiaAI Mission, used to train its own models, ended in March 2026.
items.claim: After criticism over hosting Chinese models on Token Factory, Sarvam said the platform runs on privately procured GPUs and that its IndiaAI Mission subsidised access ended in March 2026.
items.why_it_matters: Shows the sovereignty debate over who gets public compute and what startups may sell on top of open models.
items.title: Explained: Sarvam AI's Token Factory and debate over AI sovereignty goals | Artificial Intelligence News - Business Standard

items.headline: Soket AI raises $4 Mn from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant
items.quote: Soket AI has raised $4 Mn (around ₹37 Cr) from Bajaj Finserv's applied research and innovation initiative Finserv Intelligence, and Pennant Technologies
items.claim: Soket AI, maker of the IndiaAI-backed EKA-1 model, raised $4 Mn (around ₹37 Cr) from Bajaj Finserv's Finserv Intelligence and Pennant Technologies.
items.why_it_matters: Funding for an Indian sovereign-model lab signals where model-building jobs and enterprise demand may grow.
items.title: Soket AI Raises $4 Mn From Bajaj Finserv To Expand Its AI Model Horizon

items.headline: CtrlS targets 4.4 GW data centre capacity by 2030
items.quote: CtrlS Datacentres is targeting 4.4 GW of capacity by 2030, with investments spanning established technology hubs and smaller cities
items.claim: CtrlS is targeting 4.4 GW of capacity by 2030 and recently announced a ₹10,000 crore, 150 MW AI factory in Bodh Gaya, Bihar, plus a ₹400 crore, 12 MW Patna data centre.
items.why_it_matters: More domestic GPU and cloud capacity in tier-2 cities could lower compute costs for Indian builders.
items.title: Inside CtrlS’s 4.4 GW Bet on India’s Data Centre Boom

items.headline: Humyn Labs raises $47M Series A led by Accel
items.quote: The funding comprises $26 million in equity led by Accel
items.claim: India's Humyn Labs raised $47 million in Series A financing: $26 million equity led by Accel plus $21 million venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton.
items.why_it_matters: Indian teams are being funded to supply robotics training data to US labs, a niche a student builder could target.
items.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed US robotics companies the data they need | TechCrunch

items.headline: August AI raises $12M from Accel and Peak XV
items.quote: August AI has raised $12 million from Accel and Peak XV Partners
items.claim: August AI raised $12 million from Accel and Peak XV Partners and launched an AI agent that phones doctors, pharmacies and insurers for US patients.
items.why_it_matters: An IIT-BHU founder funded by top Indian VCs for a voice-agent product, a buildable pattern.
items.title: IIT-BHU alumnus Anuruddh Mishra's August AI raises $12 million to take on US healthcare paperwork

items.headline: OpenAI brings free ChatGPT Plus for researchers to India
items.quote: New grants provide three ChatGPT Plus seats in a research workspace, free for 12 months, covering the recipient and up to two collaborators.
items.claim: OpenAI's researcher programme extends to India; applications open Monday, November 30, with 50,000 new grants globally, each giving three ChatGPT Plus seats free for 12 months.
items.why_it_matters: Only faculty and postdocs with a recent arXiv/bioRxiv/ChemRxiv paper qualify, so students should ask their guide.
items.title: OpenAI Offers Free ChatGPT Plus Access to Indian Researchers Under Global Initiative

items.headline: Dreamteam raises $53M from Together Fund, Accel, Premji Invest
items.quote: Dreamteam raised $53 million from Together Fund, Accel and Premji Invest.
items.claim: Dreamteam, an AI-first CRM founded in 2025 by former Freshworks leaders, raised $53 million from Together Fund, Accel and Premji Invest.
items.why_it_matters: Shows investors backing agent-based enterprise software built by Indian founders within a year of founding.
items.title: Daily Indian Funding Roundup & Key News - 17 November 2026: Dreamteam Raises $53 Million, Urban Company Opens ₹2,500 Crore QIP

items.headline: Disseqt AI raises $8M led by Gresham House Ventures
items.quote: Disseqt AI raised $8 Mn in a funding round led by Gresham House Ventures
items.claim: Disseqt AI, which builds AI agents for AI governance and testing, raised $8 Mn (about ₹75 Cr) led by Gresham House Ventures; cricketer Rahul Dravid participated as an angel.
items.why_it_matters: AI governance and testing is drawing money; a niche with demand for engineers.
items.title: Disseqt AI Raises $8 Mn To Scale International Operations

items.headline: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini, Apache-2.0 looped MoE for local use
items.quote: The model is distributed as a single checkpoint of about 20GB, in mixed NVFP4 and MXFP8 precisions.
items.claim: The Inkling 2 Mini card lists 26.4B parameters (3.4B active, 5.4B effective with three loop passes), a 1M-token context, a roughly 20GB checkpoint and an Apache-2.0 licence. It names Apple silicon with 32GB or more memory and DGX Spark as supported local hardware.
items.why_it_matters: A multimodal open model with a 1M context and a stated 32GB-Mac target is something a student with a decent laptop can try.
items.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini · Hugging Face

items.headline: Unsloth publishes GGUF quantisations of Inkling 2 Mini
items.quote: llama serve -hf unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_M
items.claim: Unsloth's GGUF repo for Inkling 2 Mini (Apache-2.0) shows how to run the UD-Q4_K_M quant with llama.cpp, Ollama and Docker Model Runner.
items.why_it_matters: One command pulls a quantised build into llama.cpp or Ollama, so you can test the model without converting weights yourself.
items.title: unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF · Hugging Face

items.headline: Tencent publishes Hy4-flash weights: 220B total, 12B active, 1M context
items.quote: featuring 220B total parameters (including 64B Engram parameters) with just 12B active parameters per token.
items.claim: Tencent's Hy4-flash card describes a 220B-parameter model with 12B active per token, text and image input and up to 1M tokens of context. The licence shown is tencent-hy-license, not a standard open licence.
items.why_it_matters: Weights are open to download but the custom licence needs reading before any project use; it is too large for laptops.
items.title: tencent/Hy4-flash · Hugging Face

items.headline: CERN lists Summer Student Programme 2027 positions
items.quote: you are pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (not a PhD) in Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or Mathematics
items.claim: CERN's careers page lists Summer Student Programme 2027 and openlab 2027 two-month onsite contracts; applicants must have completed at least 6 semesters of full-time study by the start of summer.
items.why_it_matters: A third-year CS student will have six semesters done by summer 2027, so this fits; the page shows no dated deadline, so check it soon.

opportunity.title: CERN Summer Student Programme 2027
opportunity.audience: Bachelor/Master students in Physics, Engineering, CS or Maths with at least 6 semesters completed
opportunity.eligibility_quote: have completed at least 6 semesters of full-time university studies in one of these fields.
opportunity.note: Deadline date not stated on the fetched page; listed as rolling until a dated deadline is confirmed.

items.title: Summer Studentship – careers.cern

items.headline: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, raising $81.3 billion
items.quote: generating $81.3 billion in proceeds and surpassing SpaceX’s $75 billion record to become the largest IPO in history by proceeds raised
items.claim: TechCrunch reports Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the $70-$78 range, selling 980 million shares for $81.3 billion in proceeds, valued at roughly $1.5 trillion fully diluted.
items.why_it_matters: The company behind Claude is now public, so its filings and earnings become a trackable signal for AI spending and hiring.
items.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range | TechCrunch

items.headline: Nvidia Q3 revenue hits $115.8 billion, up 103%, under interim CEO
items.quote: Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.
items.claim: Nvidia reported Q3 fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year on year, with Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion, on 17 Nov 2026; Colette Kress is interim CEO.
items.why_it_matters: Demand for GPUs is still accelerating, so skills in CUDA and inference tuning stay valuable.
items.title: NVIDIA Corporation - NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 NVIDIA

items.headline: Anthropic opens at $111.50 on Nasdaq, closes first day at $97.17
items.quote: Anthropic shares began trading at $111.50, spiking more than 30 percent above the initial public offering price, before closing at $97.17
items.claim: Anthropic began trading Thursday 19 Nov 2026 at $111.50 and closed at $97.17, more than 17 percent above the $83 IPO price.
items.why_it_matters: Shows public-market appetite for AI labs despite bubble worries, which shapes how funded and hiring the AI sector stays.
items.title: Anthropic begins trading in biggest IPO on recordemailPrint this ArticleView CommentsPrint this ArticleView Comments

items.headline: Plural raises €1bn third fund for European defence, energy and AI start-ups
items.quote: Plural, the London-based venture firm run by former founders, has raised €1bn ($1.1bn).
items.claim: Plural raised €1bn ($1.1bn), two-thirds for a third early-stage fund and the rest for an opportunities fund; it will back start-ups in energy, AI infrastructure, defence and health.
items.why_it_matters: A large new fund signals where European early-stage money is heading, useful if you plan to join or found a deep-tech start-up.
items.title: Plural raises €1bn for European start-ups in defence, energy and AI

items.headline: External sandbox pattern lets Claude Code, Codex and Pi run code in isolation
items.quote: Each of these implementations offers the same localhost API. You can then configure Pi, Claude Code, or Codex to send API calls to that sandbox
items.claim: Simon Willison and Prime Radiant released three sandbox server implementations (v86, Apple Containers, Quicksand) with one localhost API, plus an optional HTTP/HTTPS allow-list proxy and credential replacement.
items.why_it_matters: You can run a coding agent against local models without risking your laptop, and learn the sandbox pattern with working code.
items.title: External sandboxes for coding agents

items.headline: UK AISI has no legal power to compel model access
items.quote: AISI has no legal power to compel companies to share models, relying on the goodwill of frontier labs
items.claim: A Tech Policy Press commentary says the UK AI Security Institute relies on lab goodwill for pre-deployment access, and cites Politico reporting that the White House asked labs to withhold new models from AISI until US reviews finished; access was restored after 17 days.
items.why_it_matters: Shows how fragile government model testing is, and that open tools like AISI's Inspect evaluation framework are where students can contribute.
items.title: Britain’s AI Assurance Approach Needs a Second Act | TechPolicy.Press

items.headline: US midterm results may drive state data center and AI rules
items.quote: Newly elected governors and local ballot measures are likely to drive increased state and local regulation
items.claim: A law-firm briefing dated November 16, 2026 says new governors and ballot measures are likely to bring more state and local regulation, lengthening data center timelines; it flags Texas as a state to watch.
items.why_it_matters: US state rules shape where AI infrastructure gets built and which compliance rules products face.
items.title: How the Midterm Results Could Reshape AI and Data Center Regulations, and More Developments | Publications | Insights | Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP
